guidance_for_write_eval_script_agent:
The test run failed because the environment variables OPENAI_API_KEY and SERPER_API_KEY were not set at runtime inside the container. The eval script contains the line: 

/export OPENAI_API_KEY="${OPENAI_API_KEY:?Environment variable OPENAI_API_KEY must be set}"/

which causes the script to abort if these variables are not defined. To fix this, revise the eval script to either (1) accept these environment variables as mandatory inputs when starting the container and clearly document this requirement, or (2) provide fallback dummy tokens or mock environment variable values for testing purposes if actual keys are not available, so tests can proceed without this stopping error. This is not a Dockerfile setup problem since the Dockerfile has placeholders for these keys but does not set them. Ensure the eval script clearly throws error if environment variables are not set, or modify it to handle missing keys gracefully for proper test execution.
